change.title: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5

tasks.reasoning:
The call sites pass the model through variables or constants (e.g. TRAIL_FINDER_MODEL), so the usage map does not show the literal model IDs. This repo pins @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.71.2 and anthropic>=0.40.0, which dates it to the Sonnet 4.5 era, so claude-sonnet-4-5(-20250929) is very likely the configured model. The migration agent should grep for 'claude-sonnet-4-5' in code, env defaults, config and model registries, then replace it with claude-sonnet-5-5. On the tool-using call sites it must also remove or relax any forced tool_choice (any/tool) and any thinking {type:'disabled'}, since both return 400 on sonnet-5-5. If no sonnet-4-5 reference exists, close the task as a no-op. Requests to the retired model hard-fail after the deadline, so urgency is high.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-09-28-sonnet-5-5-breaking (other): Code written for Sonnet 5 can break on claude-sonnet-5-5 (thinking disabled, forced tool_choice return 400). The named replacement for claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 is claude-sonnet-5-5. Its breaking behaviour (disabled thinking and forced tool_choice any/tool return 400) only bites once the repo switches to that model, which is the edit this task makes. The tool-using call sites (route.ts:272, payi-proxy main.py:319) must be checked for forced tool_choice as part of the same swap.
  Source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/release-notes/api
  "Forced tool use (tool_choice types any and tool) returns a 400 error."

callSites.why: messages.create with model TRAIL_FINDER_MODEL and tools. If this resolves to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 it fails after Nov 30. Moving to sonnet-5-5 also makes forced tool_choice return 400.
messages.create with a configurable model. It may be set to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.
messages.create with a configurable model and a system prompt. It may be set to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.
Anthropic messages.create judge call, which may name claude-sonnet-4-5.
Python messages.create. The model may be claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.
Python messages.create with tools. The model may be sonnet-4-5, and forced tool_choice would 400 on sonnet-5-5.
Python messages.create. The model may be claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.

record.prBody:
## claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 [Not affected]

### Change

No edits made. Searches of code, config, docs and env templates found no reference to claude-sonnet-4-5 or claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. The repo's configured Anthropic models are claude-sonnet-4-20250514, claude-opus-4-20250514 and the claude-3.x family. These are different model IDs from the one retiring on 2026-11-30.

No files changed.

### Why

The retirement only affects requests that name claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, and none do. There is also no forced tool_choice or thinking:disabled setting to fix, because nothing is switched to claude-sonnet-5-5. I did not read the call sites at route.ts:272 or main.py:319.

> | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The Prisma client is generated from prisma/schema.prisma and is not committed. Install scripts were off, so the typecheck and build would fail on missing @prisma/client types without this step.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Other Anthropic model IDs in the repo, such as claude-sonnet-4-20250514 and the claude-3.x models, may have their own retirement dates. This task did not cover them.
- A runtime environment variable or database setting (the admin AI-provider defaultModel) could set claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. That value could not be seen from the repo.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.

---

preparation.reasoning: package.json has no postinstall or prepare script, so nothing generated the Prisma client. The schema uses prisma-client-js, and Prisma 7 keeps the datasource URL in its config, which probably reads DATABASE_URL. Running prisma generate with a placeholder DATABASE_URL fixes that. The auth and app URL variables are placeholders so modules that read them at build time can load.

change.title: New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01

source.quote: This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`.

tasks.reasoning:
The TS side is pinned at 0.71.2 and keeps sending anthropic-version 2023-06-01, so nothing breaks there until the repo upgrades. This task is the one coherent move to 2026-10-21. It bumps @anthropic-ai/sdk to 1.x and fixes the MessageParam union typing. It removes temperature/top_p/top_k from every request builder. It checks document/citation placement and decides on OpenTelemetry (openTelemetry:false if a global tracer provider exists). The Python proxy is more pressing: requirements.txt only says anthropic>=0.40.0. A new image build could pull the Python 1.x SDK and silently move to 2026-10-21. The agent should either pin anthropic<1 or make the Python calls compatible and upgrade deliberately. The usage map does not show temperature at any call site, but the agent must grep for temperature/top_p/top_k (judge-service especially) because the response and option handling was not read. The old version has no published removal date, so the deadline is left empty and urgency is medium.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-10-21-sdk-typescript-1-0-0 (sdk-major): npm @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends API version 2026-10-21 by default; MessageParam becomes a union, temperature/top_p/top_k removed, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry SDKs must move to v1 too. @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 is how the TS side adopts API version 2026-10-21. Bumping from 0.71.2 to 1.x and fixing its type changes (MessageParam union, removed temperature/top_p/top_k) is the TS half of this move.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "* **api:** add support for new API version 2026-10-21"
- anthropic:2026-10-21-sampling-params-removed (field-removed): In API version 2026-10-21, temperature, top_p and top_k in Messages and Batch requests return 400. temperature/top_p/top_k only return 400 under API version 2026-10-21. Stripping them from the request builders is part of adopting the new version.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` returns a 400 error, even at the parameter’s default value."
- anthropic:2026-10-21-document-citations-user-assistant-errors (other): In API version 2026-10-21, document blocks in assistant messages and citations on text blocks in user messages return 400. Only enforced under 2026-10-21. Checking that anthropic.ts:163 (content/anthropicMessages construction) never puts document blocks in assistant turns or citations on user text is part of the same version move.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that places a `document` block directly in an `assistant` message returns a 400 error."
- anthropic:2026-10-14-ts-sdk-otel-default (other): TypeScript SDK 0.134.0 auto-creates OpenTelemetry spans and trace headers if a global tracer provider exists (unsure if affects; opt out with openTelemetry:false). OTel auto-instrumentation starts at TS SDK 0.134.0, which the repo passes on the way from 0.71.2 to 1.0.0. Whether to set openTelemetry:false is decided in the same SDK bump.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "If your app registers a global tracer provider, the SDK will create spans with it after upgrading, and they'll be exported with the rest of your traces."

callSites.why: TS messages.create. After the SDK 1.0 bump it sends 2026-10-21, so the MessageParam typing and any sampling params must be fixed.
Builds anthropicMessages/content/system for messages.create. The MessageParam union type change applies here, and the document/citation placement must be checked under 2026-10-21.
TS messages.create with tools. It must drop any temperature/top_p/top_k and type-check against SDK 1.0.
Anthropic messages.create judge call. Judge code often sets temperature, which returns 400 under 2026-10-21.
The Python anthropic SDK is constrained only by >=0.40.0, so a fresh install can pull Python anthropic 1.x, which sends 2026-10-21 by default.
Same unpinned Python SDK. Any sampling params or document placement would 400 under 2026-10-21.

record.prBody:
## New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01 [Needs review]

### Change

Bumped @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.71.2 -> ^1.4.0 (sends anthropic-version 2026-10-21). Pinned Python proxy to anthropic>=0.40.0,<1 so image builds don't silently move versions. Added scripts/check-anthropic-version.mjs (stubbed fetch, asserts header 2026-10-21); fails before, passes after. Typecheck and build pass with no source changes needed.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `scripts/check-anthropic-version.mjs`
- `services/payi-proxy/requirements.txt`

### Why

SDK 1.x moves to API version 2026-10-21; the Python requirement was unbounded and could pull 1.x unexpectedly.

> This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`.

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| anthropic-version | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- anthropic-version, added by the agent: `export DATABASE_URL='postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5433/trailblazer?schema=public' NEXTAUTH_SECRET='placeholder' NEXTAUTH_URL='http://localhost:3636'; node scripts/check-anthropic-version.mjs` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (Install scripts were off, so the Prisma client (@prisma/client) was never generated. Both tsc and next build import it.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Python proxy was not migrated to SDK 1.x, only pinned below it; upgrade deliberately later.
- No OpenTelemetry usage found in the repo (no tracer provider), so openTelemetry:false was not set.
- Did not inspect in detail that anthropic.ts:163 never puts document blocks in assistant turns; grep found no document/citation usage.
- The agent wrote no test of this change and gave no reason why none can be written.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- TS requests now send anthropic-version 2026-10-21.
- No temperature/top_p/top_k exist anywhere in src or services, so nothing was removed.
- Python proxy stays on 2023-06-01 for now.

---

review.summary: The PR bumps @anthropic-ai/sdk from ^0.71.2 to ^1.4.0, adds a script that checks the outgoing anthropic-version header, and pins the Python proxy to anthropic<1. No application source changes. Typecheck and build pass, and the header check shows the TS SDK now sends 2026-10-21. Nothing shows the call sites behave the same under the new API version: the guide says it 'lists the code changes', yet none were made, and the only runtime check mocks fetch with a minimal text response. The Python side is held on 2023-06-01 rather than migrated, so the app now runs on two API versions. needs-review is the right grade.

concerns.issue: Line ~272 uses tools: [{type: 'web_search_20250305', ...}] and walks response.content for type === 'text'. Under 2026-10-21 the server-tool response blocks, stop_reason values or tool versions may have changed. Typecheck passing only shows the 1.x types still accept this literal; it does not show the live API does. I could not confirm this from the quote; check the 'Server tools'/'Responses' sections of migration-2026-10-21.md.

Lines ~101 and ~163 (messages.create with image blocks, and with a `system` string that can be undefined) were not touched. The response handling (content.find for type 'text', usage.input_tokens/output_tokens) was not checked against the 2026-10-21 response shape. The check script's mock returns the old-style message, so it proves the header and nothing else.

The Anthropic call at line ~166 is not shown and was not changed or exercised. The other named sites at lines 180, 194 and 211 are OpenAI/Gemini calls, unaffected by this change. Someone should confirm the Anthropic judge path still parses its JSON from the response the same way.

Pinning anthropic<1 keeps the proxy on 2023-06-01 while the Next.js direct path moves to 2026-10-21, so the same feature behaves differently depending on whether PAYI_PROXY_URL is set. It also changes behaviour: the old unbounded >=0.40.0 would have pulled a 1.x SDK on a fresh install. The pin may also be needed for payi_instrument compatibility, but that should be stated. No timeline is given for migrating main.py:170/319/438.

It imports the deep path '../node_modules/@anthropic-ai/sdk/index.mjs', which may break in later SDK releases. It is not wired into package.json scripts or CI, so it will not catch regressions. It only asserts the header value.

The SDK's license changed from MIT to Apache-2.0, and new transitive deps were added (@opentelemetry/api, standardwebhooks, fast-sha256 under Unlicense). Many unrelated 'peer': true flags were also dropped, probably due to a different npm version. This is lockfile noise worth a license/review check.

checkFirst: Read migration-2026-10-21.md for changes to web_search tool versions, content block types, stop_reason and the system param, and compare against route.ts:272 and anthropic.ts:101/163.
Run one live (or recorded) trail-finder search via the direct-Anthropic path with the 1.4.0 SDK and confirm the response parses into recommendations.
Decide whether the payi-proxy should stay on anthropic<1 (2023-06-01), and why: payi compatibility, or deferred migration. Document it or open a follow-up.
Confirm the Anthropic branch of judge-service.ts (~line 166) still extracts text and JSON correctly under 2026-10-21.

swharr/TrailblazerAI:anthropic:2026-11-30-retire-claude-sonnet-4-5: The call sites pass the model through variables or constants (e.g. TRAIL_FINDER_MODEL), so the usage map does not show the literal model IDs. This repo pins @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.71.2 and anthropic>=0.40.0, which dates it to the Sonnet 4.5 era, so claude-sonnet-4-5(-20250929) is very likely the configured model. The migration agent should grep for 'claude-sonnet-4-5' in code, env defaults, config and model registries, then replace it with claude-sonnet-5-5. On the tool-using call sites it must also remove or relax any forced tool_choice (any/tool) and any thinking {type:'disabled'}, since both return 400 on sonnet-5-5. If no sonnet-4-5 reference exists, close the task as a no-op. Requests to the retired model hard-fail after the deadline, so urgency is high.
swharr/TrailblazerAI:anthropic:2026-10-21-api-version-2026-10-21: The TS side is pinned at 0.71.2 and keeps sending anthropic-version 2023-06-01, so nothing breaks there until the repo upgrades. This task is the one coherent move to 2026-10-21. It bumps @anthropic-ai/sdk to 1.x and fixes the MessageParam union typing. It removes temperature/top_p/top_k from every request builder. It checks document/citation placement and decides on OpenTelemetry (openTelemetry:false if a global tracer provider exists). The Python proxy is more pressing: requirements.txt only says anthropic>=0.40.0. A new image build could pull the Python 1.x SDK and silently move to 2026-10-21. The agent should either pin anthropic<1 or make the Python calls compatible and upgrade deliberately. The usage map does not show temperature at any call site, but the agent must grep for temperature/top_p/top_k (judge-service especially) because the response and option handling was not read.
